canonical_statement: For n : Nat and p : Real with 1 < p < n, every smooth compactly supported real-valued function on Euclidean R^n satisfies the first-order Sobolev inequality with Talenti's displayed gamma-function constant, and that constant is no greater than every other constant valid for the same test class.
conclusion: The explicit talentiConstant n p is admissible, and for every C, admissibility of C implies talentiConstant n p <= C.

encoding_decisions.lp_norm: The classical finite real integral expression (integral |f|^p)^(1/p), rather than an ENNReal eLpNorm, so the displayed inequality and optimal constant have the source's Real codomain.
encoding_decisions.gradient: Mathlib's total gradient operator; smoothness ensures the intended derivative branch.
encoding_decisions.sharpness: Least admissible constant on exactly the same smooth compactly supported test class.

mutation_tests: mutationChangedTestClass drops smoothness and compact support
degenerate_cases: The hypotheses force n >= 2 and exclude p <= 1 and p >= n. The zero function remains in the test class. No endpoint, completion-space, or extremizer-classification claim is included.
status_boundary: This node freezes and elaborates the exact inequality-plus-optimality proposition. It does not prove Talenti's theorem, verify the primary-source formula transcription, establish alternate-encoding transports, or close any later node.
